records.reviewer: Codex campaign lead · independent of the builder
records.task: Follow the broad head, uncinate turn, body and tapered tail in 3D and orient the visible body toward the posterior venous landmark at the saved s1233 frame.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The saved cut loses raw-label loops and reaches 10.18 mm error against a 3.0 mm limit. Three enclosed mask voids account for much of the difference. Even the filled exterior has a 6.81 mm miss on a small tangential loop.
scoreEvidence.form: The head and hooked uncinate contour remain distinct in reverse. The close-up still has uneven lobulated relief along the inner margin. The matched previous view looks similar at this scale.
scoreEvidence.readability: The registered overlay locates the body anterior to the venous landmark. I used the axial scene and reverse surface to follow the head-to-tail curve. The default oblique scene and grayscale alone leave the ends hard to identify.
scoreEvidence.economy: The packed mesh falls from 16,620 triangles and 299,240 bytes to 5,800 and 104,432. The worst 24-view silhouette departure against the smoothed density input is 0.79 px at 3 px/mm.

records.note: The trial can illustrate whole-organ orientation. Its raw CT and full-section deviations exceed the frozen limits. The survey continues to use its worked acquisition.
records.disposition: Hold · keep the existing sweep and chapter
